art_note: Clean product and detail shots support a refined presentation, though lifestyle and sizing graphics lower overall campaign luxury.
desc_en: An essential garment crafted for the season. This lightweight cardigan features a minimalist V-neck silhouette and long sleeves. Designed with a refined four-button front closure and two functional pockets. A versatile piece suited for daily life, office wear, or relaxed moments. Available made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una prenda esencial confeccionada para la temporada. Este cárdigan ligero presenta una silueta minimalista con cuello en V y mangas largas. Diseñado con una refinada botonadura frontal de cuatro botones y dos bolsillos funcionales. Una pieza versátil adaptada para el uso diario, la oficina o momentos de descanso. Disponible bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
